detail: R-rule-blocks-written-before-under-a-now-s-b44b: Rule blocks written before under a now-skipped directory stay frozen

data.title: Rule blocks written before under a now-skipped directory stay frozen
data.label: RISK
data.what: a block an older plugin wrote under vendor/x or a symlinked dir outside the walk is never taken back now that the writer skips it, and the hint says the rule is not rendered there (B2 review L1)
data.fix: when plan.read(target) holds a block for the slug, say an earlier rendering remains and must be removed by hand
data.status_why: hint names an earlier rendering left under a skipped dir; probe guarded (_frozen_block) (T-2026-10-30-2332 round 2)

detail: R-rules-skip-comparison-is-case-sensitive-a50b: RULES_SKIP comparison is case-sensitive on case-insensitive filesystems

data.title: RULES_SKIP comparison is case-sensitive on case-insensitive filesystems
data.label: RISK
data.what: dirs: [Vendor/x] with vendor/ on disk passes the writer and is pruned by the walk on macOS (B2 review L2)
data.fix: compare case-insensitively or resolve each component to its on-disk spelling
data.status_why: writer's unwalked_dir compares casefolded; the walker keeps exact names so it never prunes more than before (T-2026-10-30-2332 round 2)
